integrity: Analytic universal proof; accompanying finite numerical checks corroborate but do not replace it. No independent audit or external certification has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Applies to self-STFT of signals with exactly three taps in a progression of unit step and cyclic orders >=5. Does not classify other supports or distinct windows. The numerical prime-order lower bound is already implied by Krahmer–Pfander–Rashkov Proposition 4.4; the new component is the complete parity-dependent spectrum and optimizer classification. Unindexed prior literature remains a possible overlap risk.
title: Parity-rigid ambiguity-support spectra for primitive three-tap cyclic signals
